notes.title: Major Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/390966c1ccc296b7a1dbb108c59f771eea84053e.png[/img]

[h2]New Construct Browser[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/4b734c28d5f6d94c1e566cb05a705e8384809ffa.png[/img]

Better browsing interface for prebuilt build constructs, Steam Workshop downloads, and your saved constructs.
You can also upload your saved constructs to Steam Workshop by hovering the mouse over items and clicking on the upload button.

[h2]Construct Editor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/8e443fd615b0b3dc80bf426beb2f4d51cee333d8.png[/img]

Construct editor has a limited building area, but you can convert your build into a construct without selecting a volume. You can also import any existing construct and start changing it.

[h2]Unique Bricks[/h2]
Some prebuilt constructs include unique bricks not listed inside the brick collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/d7df89b9081b3920d37ec4c20d34404e85136ed1.png[/img]
The Star icon indicates unique bricks are included within the construct. 

To use the unique bricks, you can place the construct in your scene and grab the unique bricks, or you can import the prebuilt construct into the construct editor and see all the unique bricks listed in a special category. You can add these bricks into your customizable pallets to easily access them later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/5dc0e5a80a3b817b583ddb389c7783318f1d2bbe.png[/img]


[h2]Painting objects has become much easier[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/f4bf1ceff090b49119110134a0b8dfe9f46df262.png[/img]

You can paint all parts of an object by simply clicking on that part using the paint tool. Some parts of objects might not be easily accessible to click. In that case, you can hold down the "1", "2", or "3" key and click on any part of an object to paint the first, second, or third part of the object. For example, if you want to change the color of the liquid inside a bottle, you will have to hold down the "2" key and click anywhere on the bottle using the paint tool.

[h2]Custom Pallets[/h2]
Any brick or figure can be added to your custom pallets. Saved bricks will retain their color and material.

[h2]Other Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]UI Themes in the settings window.
[*]New steam achievements.
[/list]

[h2]New Bricks[/h2]
[list]
[*]125 new bricks.
[*]1 new figure.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Few bricks have been moved into the Gaia collection.
[*]New title screen.
[/list]

[h2]Copy Volume Tool:[/h2]
Click on the tool button or press the [N] key to enter the volume selection tool. You can readjust the selected volume by dragging its sides. After selecting the volume, press the [N] key or the button aging to copy the volume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/4bdb65531d6e970d8141dbd283d19eabe69c701e.png[/img]

[h2]Command Panel:[/h2]
The command panel displays buttons that act as a replacement for keyboard commands, such as undo [CTRL+Z] and rotate [R] keys. This panel is hidden by default and can be activated using the settings window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38894110/dc9d7ab222b3bf75f7f023df63afd6963d702038.png[/img]

notes.title: Mason Dev Diary #01
notes.content:
[h2]Upcoming Content:[/h2]

[h3]Modernity Collection[/h3]
This collection is currently under development and will be added to the game in a few weeks. Initially, the collection will contain very few items and figures. This content update is being rushed just to show Mason is not only about the ancient era, and more themes will be added to Mason in the future. Modernity collection and Antiquity collection will be revisited, and continue to receive more content in the future.

[h3]Constructs[/h3]
Sometimes you may want to build something once, and use it multiple times. For example, you may want to build a house and place it on the scene multiple times to build a city. The "Construct" feature lets you do that. You will be able to save a structure and place it on the map. After the release of the Modernity collection, this feature will go under active development.

[h2]Future Plans:[/h2]
Mason will continue to receive free content and features. It is too early to share a clear long-term roadmap at this moment because the plans might change based on player feedback and other factors.
